show.description: A mischievous yet kind-hearted magician, Veer, is forced into a marriage with wheelchair-bound CEO Shaifali due to family greed and betrayal, turning two broken lives into an unlikely partnership. As conspiracies, poison plots, and humiliation surround them, Veer secretly uses his powers to protect Shaifali, while love slowly grows between duty, dignity, and destiny.
